an9.40:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] yasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye āraññakassa nāgassa gocarapasutassa hatthīpi hatthiniyopi hatthikalabhāpi hatthicchāpi purato gantvā tiṇaggāni chindanti, tena bhikkhave, āraññako nāgo aṭṭīyati harāyati jigucchati.
an9.40:1.2: yasmiṃ bhikkhave, samaye āraññakassa nāgassa gocarapasutassa hatthīpi hatthiniyopi hatthikalabhāpi hatthicchāpāpi obhaggobhaggaṃ sākhābhaṅgaṃ khādanti. tena bhikkhave, āraññako nāgo aṭṭīyati harāyati jigucchati.
an9.40:1.3: yasmiṃ bhikkhave, samaye āraññakassa nāgassa ogāhaṃ otiṇṇassa hatthīpi hatthiniyopi hatthikalabhāpi hatthicchāpāpi purato purato gantvā soṇḍāya udakaṃ ālolenti. tena bhikkhave, āraññako nāgo aṭṭīyati harāyati jigucchati.
an9.40:1.4: yasmiṃ bhikkhave, samaye āraññakassa nāgassa ogāhaṃ otiṇṇassa hatthiniyo kāyaṃ upanighaṃsantiyo gacchanti, tena bhikkhave, āraññako nāgo aṭṭīyati harāyati jigucchati.
an9.40:2.1: tasmiṃ bhikkhave, samaye āraññakassa nāgassa evaṃ hoti:
an9.40:2.2: “ahaṃ kho etarahi ākiṇṇo viharāmi, hatthihi hatthinīhi hatthikalabhehi hatthicchāpehi.
an9.40:2.3: chinnaggāni ceva tiṇāni khādāmi. obhaggobhaggañca me sākhābhaṅgaṃ khādanti. āvilāniceva pānīyāni pivāmi ogāhaṃ me otiṇṇassa hatthiniyo kāyaṃ upanighaṃsantiyo gacchanti
an9.40:2.5: so aparena samayena eko gaṇasmā vūpakaṭṭho viharati acchinnaggāniceva tiṇāni khādati. obhaggobhaggañcassa sākhābhaṅgaṃ na khādanti. anāvilāni ca pānīyāni pivati. ogāhañcassa otiṇṇassa na hatthiniyo kāyaṃ upanighaṃsantiyo gacchanti.
an9.40:3.1: tasmiṃ bhikkhave, samaye āraññakassa nāgassa evaṃ hoti:
an9.40:3.2: “ahaṃ kho pubbe ākiṇṇo vihāsiṃ hatthihi hatthinīhi hatthikalabhehi hatthicchāpehi, chinnaggāni ceva tiṇāni khādiṃ, obhaggobhaggañca me sākhābhaṅgaṃ khādiṃsu. āvilāni ca pānīyāni āpāyiṃ, ogāhañca me otiṇṇassa hatthiniyo kāyaṃ upanighaṃsantiyo agamaṃsu. sohaṃ etarahi eko gaṇasmā vūpakaṭṭho viharāmi, acchinnaggāni ceva tiṇāni khādāmi. obhaggobhaggañca me sākhābhaṅgaṃ na khādanti anāvilāni ca pānīyāni pivāmi, ogāhañca otiṇṇassa na hatthiniyo kāyaṃ upanighaṃsantiyo gacchanti.” so soṇḍāya sākhābhaṅgaṃ bhañjitvā sākhābhaṅgena kāyaṃ parimadditvā attamano kaṇḍuṃ saṃhanti.’
an9.40:4.1: evameva kho bhikkhave, yasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu ākiṇṇo viharati bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīhi upāsakehi upāsikāhi raññā rājamahāmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi, tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhussa evaṃ hoti:
an9.40:4.2: ahaṃ kho etarahi ākiṇṇo viharāmi, bhikkhūhī bhikkhunīhi upāsakehi upāsikāhi raññā rājamahāmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi.
an9.40:4.4: so vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajati: araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ.
an9.40:4.5: so araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
an9.40:5.1: so abhijjhaṃ loke pahāya vigatābhijjhena cetasā viharati abhijjhāya cittaṃ parisodheti,
an9.40:5.2: byāpāda padosaṃ pahāya abyāpanna citto viharati sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī, byāpāda padosā cittaṃ parisodheti.
an9.40:5.3: thīna middhaṃ pahāya vigatathīnamiddho viharati ālokasaññī sato sampajāno, thīnamiddhā cittaṃ parisodheti,
an9.40:5.4: uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahāya anuddhato viharati ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto. uddhaccakukkuccā cittaṃ parisodheti,
an9.40:5.5: vicikicchaṃ pahāya tiṇṇavicikiccho viharati akathaṅkathī kusalesu dhammesu, vicikicchāya cittaṃ parisodheti.
an9.40:5.6: so ime pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe
an9.40:5.7: vivicceva kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an9.40:6.1: sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ananto ākāsoti, ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati,
an9.40:6.3: sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇanti, viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati, so attamano kaṇḍuṃ saṃhanti.
an9.40:6.4: sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati,
an9.40:6.5: sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati …pe…
an9.40:6.6: sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati, paññāya cassa disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā honti.
